Data.subject: Labour, Employment, Wages and Productivity
Data.title: Total Employment In UN-defined Tourism Industries, Annual
Data.footnote: The UN (United Nations)-defined tourism industries include industries that are not in the Singapore Tourism Board (STB)-defined tourism industries, which are mentioned on STB s website (https://www.stb.gov.sg/licensing-support/tourism-human-capital).  Total employment data are compiled primarily from administrative records, with the self-employed component estimated from the Labour Force Survey.  Employment data from administrative records comprise all persons in employment.  However, it excludes men who are serving their 2-year full-time national service in the Singapore Armed Forces, Police and Civil Defence Forces.  Data are as of December of each year.  Data are used for SDG 8.9.2 'Employed persons in the tourism industries'.  Please refer to the Sustainable Development Goals (SDG) Global Metadata (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/metadata) for more information on SDG 8.9.2.
